description: Use this when the person wants to log a meal from a photo but hasn't attached one, or the app can't hand you their photo. Opens the Almost Fire camera in the chat: they take or choose a photo there, Stoke reads each food with its grams and calories, and Log saves it. Do not use when they've attached a photo; use read_meal_photo.

note.description: Anything they said about the meal, for the read.

name: open_camera
title: Open the Almost Fire camera
